message: Thanks. A few questions: How many people live in your household (including you and your dad)? How many children under 18 live with you, and is any child under 5, or is anyone pregnant or a baby under 1? Does anyone have a disability? Roughly how much does the household earn from work in a year, and how much Social Security does your dad get a year? Any other income (pensions, interest, etc.)? Does anyone get health insurance through a job? Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments?
reply: Just me. No, no children. No. No. I don't really know. No idea, honestly. $0 a year. Somewhere between 600 thousand and 850 thousand a year. Yeah. About 70 thousand.

summary: Reported other income about $600-850k/yr, assets about $70k, employer health insurance, no children, no Social Security. This is far above the limits for every means-tested programme, and employer coverage rules out the ACA premium tax credit. Some answers were unclear (household size "just me" despite a dad living there, disability unknown, earned income unknown), so a caseworker should confirm.
